sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Miami voters have approved Denver-based real estate company Oak View Group's bid to take over management of the city's historic Miami Marine Stadium and restore the structure. Built in 1963 and designed by Cuban architect Hilario Candela, the concrete modernist stadium was closed in 1992 following damage from Hurricane Andrew and has sat abandoned for decades The post Miami votes to restore Hilario Candela's Marine Stadium appeared first on Dezeen .
